title: gilia gracilis var. micrantha
intro: Gilia gracilis var. micrantha, commonly known as the dwarf gilia, is a perennial plant species in the plantain family (Plantaginaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Gilia gracilis var. micrantha include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
